errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва енергията в тераколиметри
errors.evidence: The vertical axis does not show energy in "terakolimeters". It is an index where the value for the year 2008 is set to 100. The unit "terakolimeters" is fabricated.
The vertical axis range is from 50 to 150, not 100 to 150. The value 100 is the baseline for the index.

errors.text_span: Оста X е маргинализирана от 2008 г. до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The word "маргинализирана" (marginalized) is an awkward and unclear way to describe the range of the X-axis.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва видовете източници на енергия
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis represents the years from 2008 to 2018. The types of energy sources are represented by the different colored lines, not the axis itself.
The chart contains seven distinct lines corresponding to seven categories in the legend, not six.
The line for "Renewable energy" is light blue/cyan, not beige ("бежова").

errors.text_span: която започва на минимална стойност около 110
errors.evidence: According to the chart's index definition (2008 = 100), all lines start at the value 100 in 2008, not 110.
The "Total production" line ends at a value of approximately 91 in 2018, not 80.
The line representing "Nuclear energy" is pink/magenta, not green ("зелена").

errors.text_span: чиято стойност започва на около 90 тераколиметра през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The line for "Nuclear energy" starts at the index value of 100 in 2008, not 90.

errors.text_span: което започва на около 80 тераколиметра през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The line for "Solid fossil fuels" starts at the index value of 100 in 2008, not 80.

errors.text_span: се стабилизира около 80 тераколиметра през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The line for "Solid fossil fuels" does not stabilize; it shows a consistent decrease, ending at approximately 72 in 2018, not 80.

errors.text_span: което започва на около 60 тераколиметра през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The line for "Crude oil" starts at the index value of 100 in 2008, not 60.

errors.text_span: намалява до около 40 тераколиметра през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The line for "Crude oil" ends at approximately 65 in 2018, not 40.

errors.text_span: Синята линия показва производството на природен газ, което започва на около 50 тераколиметра през 2008 г. и се покачва до около 80 тераколиметра през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The line for "Natural gas" shows a steep decrease from 100 in 2008 to approximately 53 in 2018. The description incorrectly states that it starts at 50 and increases to 80.

The description fails to mention the most crucial information for interpreting the Y-axis: that it is an index where 2008 = 100, as stated in the chart's subtitle. This omission leads to numerous errors in reading the chart's values.
The description omits one of the seven lines shown in the chart, the one corresponding to the "Other" category.
